title: Haye Sajjad Keevain, Zulmaan Di Inteha Seh Gaya
body:
Bin Chadraan Day Phupiyaan Nay, Taiyon Rondeya Reh Gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
Zahra Diyan Jaaiyan Nay, Kevain Lokon Rassiyan Paiyaan
Tatheer Day Siraan Wich, Mityaan Nay Kinjh Sajaiyaan
Ay Manzar Ay, Abid Di, Akhiyan’ch Reh Gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
Kandeyan Tay Reya Turda, Rab Janay Kinjh Muhaari
Gal Ajr E Risaalat Da, Hy Paa Kay Touq Bhaari
Kevain Panjetun Di, Ghairat Nu, Ay Shaam Lay Gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
Sutday Nay Garam Paani, Jadon Shaam Day Kaminay
Akhiyan Chon Dul Gaye Nay, Yaaqoot Day Nageenay
Ghairatan Wala Syed Ay, Bas Kairay Pay Gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
Kubra Tay Sakina Nu, Kevain Shaam Lekay Jaawan
Veeran Diyan Laashan Nu, Chum Chum Ke Bharda Haawan
Jitthay Babay Di, Maqtal Si, Othay Jakay Baih Gaya
